job.title: Software Engineer
job.location: Foster City, CA or Austin, TX
job.workplace: Hybrid, at least 3 days a week in the office
job.pay_full: $86,500 – $158,100 a year (US estimated salary range), may be eligible for bonus and equity

details.about: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, connecting consumers, merchants, financial institutions and governments in more than 200 countries and territories. This Software Engineer joins the Payments Products development team, building new solutions with generative AI and modern integration patterns and helping match new ideas and technologies to business opportunities.
duties: Design, develop and implement new software solutions using generative AI and modern integration patterns
Support the implementation, fine-tuning, evaluation, integration and deployment of AI components in enterprise applications
Work with Product Office, Operations & Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Client Support and other product teams on complex projects
Help design and develop APIs that connect Visa's payment product applications and platforms
Follow best practices for quality, security, performance, scalability and resilience, and help reduce technical debt
Automate development, testing and deployment, and keep multiple services delivered and maintained
needs: A Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience
Expert-level skills in Java, Python and/or NodeJS (C++ and C# are a plus)
Experience building generative AI applications, conversational AI and RAG architectures, techniques and libraries
nice: Application security, SSDLC and cryptography fundamentals
NLP basics such as tokenization, word embeddings and sequence models
Implementing and fine-tuning models with TensorFlow, PyTorch or scikit-learn
MLOps, data preprocessing, feature engineering and model evaluation
Front-end skills in ReactJS, Angular and NodeJS
Multi-threading, concurrency, CI/CD pipelines and distributed in-memory computing such as Redis
details.benefits: Estimated US salary range $86,500 – $158,100 a year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable); pay varies with knowledge, skills, experience and location. The position may be eligible for bonus and equity. Visa's benefits package may include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, life insurance, paid time off and a wellness program.
notes: Hybrid: at least 3 days a week in the office
Work hours vary with the needs of the department
Locations: Foster City, CA or Austin, TX
